sweeps.title: One question, several conditions.
sweeps.description: Vary one parameter and repeat each condition. The example compares five humidity values with ten replicates: 50 runs independent of your saved terrarium.
sweeps.pairing: The same replicate uses the same seed across values to compare paired conditions. Different replicates receive different seeds. These are model experiments, without species calibration.
sweeps.help: Parameters: humidity, light, randomness, reposeAngle, temperatureC, windX or windZ. In the browser: up to 200 runs and 10,000 planned daily observations. Download the checkpoint before closing this page; sweeps are not saved automatically.
sweeps.ready: Ready to compare five values and ten replicates.
sweeps.download.help: The JSON includes the CSV and manifest of each run. Use the terminal for separate files per run.
sweeps.terminal.title: Run in the terminal
sweeps.terminal.help: Using the source of this version, this command runs all 50 combinations in the example:
sweeps.terminal.resume: to continue in the same directory, or use
sweeps.terminal.import: to import downloaded results. Custom configurations:
sweeps.running: {count} of {total} runs completed. Download the checkpoint to keep your results.
sweeps.completed: Sweep complete: {count} runs, without changing your saved terrarium.
sweeps.stopped: Stopped with {count} completed runs preserved. Resume here or download the checkpoint.
sweeps.cleared: Results removed from this page. The configuration and previously downloaded files are preserved.
sweeps.limit: In the browser: up to 200 runs and 10,000 planned daily observations. Use the CLI for larger plans.
